label: Serving the playground from a sandbox copy
value: uiTestServeApp builds the playground (factory.webApp) from the sandbox copy, where node_modules/thefactory-tools (a relative file:../thefactory-tools link) points at nothing. Before serving, write a git-ignored /workspace/.env.local containing THEFACTORY_TOOLS_DIR=<host path to thefactory-tools>. The path is shown in runProjectCheck's dependencyRevisions, e.g. /Users/cloud/Documents/Work/thefactory-tools. playground/vite.config.ts reads it and aliases the package's exports. The sandbox itself can't run vite build (no Rollup native binary for linux), so build on the host via uiTestServeApp/runProjectCheck.
author: agent
